<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NAV-002:20261027-original-acceptance -->
## Verified resolution — original NAV-002 acceptance

**Root cause:** SaveableStateProvider and popped-state cleanup were keyed by route strings, conflating repeated visits.

**Repair:** Composition/saveable providers and cleanup now use persisted unique entry IDs. Duplicate and same-frame pop/revisit state is independent, and restored duplicates pop independently.

**Affected implementation:** [`calf-navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/navigation/AdaptiveNavHost.kt`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/calf-navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/navigation/AdaptiveNavHost.kt) — AdaptiveNavHost / ForgetPoppedEntries; AdaptiveNavHostController entry/saver ownership.

### Original required checks reviewed
- **A -> B -> A has two independent counters and popping restores the original A.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.duplicate visits separated by another route keep independent saveable state`.
- **Consecutive A -> A produces fresh local/saveable entry state.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.consecutive duplicate visits reset plain remember and saveable state`.
- **Pop and immediately push the same route before an idle frame; the new entry is fresh.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.pop and repush before an idle frame discards the popped visit state`.
- **Restore a stack containing duplicate routes and pop each independently.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.save restore preserves duplicate entry state identity and payloads`.
- **Retain both existing #542 tests.** — passed-scoped-runtime. Methods: `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.saveable state of a destination survives navigating away and back`, `AdaptiveNavHostStateTest.saveable state of a popped destination is dropped`.

[Verbatim original-requirement/source/Git/XML review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/closure-review-20261027-001/lead-original-acceptance-review.json) at immutable evidence commit `8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838`. Owning navigation source/test/build bytes match `6eb7c66eb01b390353100c63882cd102846c7b8d`: Linux51/51 + Android-host37/37 ([40414284598](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40414284598)); macOS51/51 + iOS39/39 ([40415332643](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40415332643)). These178 target executions reuse51 source methods. The historical Apple run failed elsewhere; only the passed navigation scope is accepted. Both original upstream [Calf #542](https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/542) test bodies are retained byte-identically and passing. 

[Current staged preflight](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/8ab82a3fa41caad34cd7fb7a2d3722bfc25e3838/docs/development/evidence/ci-preflight-20261027-019/lead-review.json) passes23/23 commands,1,137 overlapping Python executions, strict documentation/actionlint and both whitespace checks; it executes zero new library/native/packaged methods.

**Compatibility / limits:** Public package/class names and legacy navigate/pop signatures retained; ADR0004 defines corrected behavior and limits. No whole-library ABI certification. Exact backStack getter type retained; old state-key semantics intentionally corrected. Original issue description, labels, upstream discussion and previous remaining notes are preserved. This closes only the original specific defect after required-scope review; minimum-platform/device/native-stack integration, whole-library API/ABI, full packaged consumers, dependency trust, legal/native-payload and all other issue/release gates remain independent and are not waived. No package, release, deployment or Pages publication.
